doctor.name: Dr. Patel
doctor.title: Dr. Patel, DMD
doctor.lede: Dr. Patel believes a good dental visit starts with listening. He takes the time to understand what matters to you, explains every option in plain language, and never rushes a decision.
bio: Dr. Patel's gentle approach puts nervous patients at ease, and his focus on family and cosmetic dentistry means everyone from a child's first check-up to a full smile makeover gets the same careful, unhurried attention.

He uses modern digital tools to show you exactly what he sees, so you always understand your treatment and its cost before anything begins. Outside the practice, he enjoys time with family and exploring Bucks County.
credentials: Ongoing training in implant and cosmetic dentistry

members.name: Linda
